actor.description: Recorded actor identity, not host-authenticated authority.

file.description: A staged file relative to the work directory. The consumer verifies its actual bytes against sha256.

relativePath.description: A slash-separated file path relative to the work directory; no absolute path, dot segment, parent traversal, drive prefix or backslash.

context.description: Supporting notes and reference files used to understand the task, separate from its inputs. Empty collections explicitly mean no extra context. Context does not grant additional execution authority.
context.title: Request context

decision.description: .works/<workId>/decisions/<id>.json: an attributed decision on an exact work revision and subject digest. Identity and authority are not authenticated by this schema.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: .works/<workId>/evidence/<id>.json: artifact metadata. Existence, actual digest and evidentiary relevance require separate checks.
evidence.title: Evidence

index.description: Version 1 of the proposed .works document format. A document must match exactly one kind. This contract does not migrate or reinterpret legacy session records.
index.title: Works document contract

inputs.description: The prompts and files the request asks the skill to act on. At least one prompt or file is required.
inputs.title: Request inputs

output.description: One produced output. Text is inline; commits identify a repository and full object ID; images and other files bind persisted artifacts. Output metadata alone does not prove correctness or publication.
output.title: Response output

request.description: .works/<workId>/requests/<id>.json: prompts and files to act on, with supporting context kept separate, against one work revision. This record alone grants no execution permission.
request.title: Request

response.description: .works/<workId>/responses/<id>.json: typed outputs produced for one request. Optional verification observations describe their checks separately; delivering an output is not a claim that the work is proved complete.

feedbackRound.description: Completed feedback-and-repair rounds for this request. Initial candidate is round zero; the caller maintains truthful history.

response.title: Response

work.description: .works/<id>/work.json: goal, declared scope, acceptance criteria and current lifecycle.
work.title: Work

@cli/curl.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/curl.note: On Windows resolve the curl executable (curl.exe), not a PowerShell alias with different argument semantics. A native web-fetch capability is not this CLI alias.
@cli/curl.purpose: Probe an HTTP endpoint using the curl executable.

@cli/git.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/git.purpose: Inspect or change Git repository state.

@cli/python.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/python.note: Resolve Python 3 from the active environment: python, python3, or py -3 as appropriate; record the selected executable and any launcher arguments.

@tools/browsercontrol.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/browsercontrol.purpose: Drive a real browser against a served route: navigate, act, capture screenshots and DOM measurements.

claude.via: mode required: the in-app Browser pane, or Claude in Chrome when the task needs the person's sessions

openai.via: mode required: Codex computer use, which opens the person's own Chrome, on a dedicated browser profile (the shared UAT identity), never the person's logged-in profile

@tools/fileread.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/fileread.purpose: Read declared workspace files and directories through the active session.

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

@tools/imageview.bind: Image inspection capability advertised by the active session; inspect actual pixels, not filenames or metadata.
@tools/imageview.purpose: Inspect image pixels through session image input or an image viewing tool.

claude.via: Attached images or an image-capable file reader.

openai.via: Attached images or an available image viewing tool.

@tools/print.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/print.purpose: Present text and artifacts in the conversation using the host rendering capabilities.

claude.via: the session's file and render hand-off, which displays an image or an HTML page in the conversation and falls back to the path or the URL

openai.via: the absolute path or the URL printed into the conversation, with the image inline where the client renders one

@tools/sourcewrite.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/sourcewrite.purpose: Edit files within the declared write scope through the active session.

@workspaces/artifacts.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/artifacts.purpose: Produced files, including images, documents and other deliverables.

@workspaces/context.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/context.purpose: Supporting reference files for a request.

@workspaces/grammar.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/grammar.purpose: The explicitly resolved grammar package directory; unavailable when no grammar package is bound.

@workspaces/inputs.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/inputs.purpose: Files supplied as the subject of a request.

@workspaces/knowledge.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/knowledge.purpose: Knowledge published by the selected skill runtime.

@workspaces/requests.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/requests.purpose: Requests with separate inputs and context.

@workspaces/responses.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/responses.purpose: Responses declaring produced outputs and execution status.

criteria.history: Record the initial audit as round zero, concrete defects by matrix entry and proof topic, and each targeted recapture or reassessment. Keep rejected evidence distinguishable and never replace measurement with a claim.

onFail.instruction: Request a corrected audit request before browser work.

items.expect: All bound source, route and rule files exist and match digests.

onFail.instruction: Request exact missing or drifted audit evidence.

items.expect: The response schema and required audit outputs pass.

onFail.instruction: Repair response metadata from actual audit artifacts.

items.expect: The response binds this audit request and revision.

onFail.instruction: Remove duplicate declarations while preserving distinct captures.

items.expect: Audit files and screenshots are present, scoped and digest-bound.

onFail.instruction: Re-read actual artifacts and correct metadata; recapture corrupt evidence.

items.expect: Observations name request criteria and current evidence.

onFail.instruction: Correct observation references to this audit revision.

items.expect: Captures show the bound commit on the exact attested route and actual rendered family.

onFail.instruction: Record the endpoint, ancestry, family or guarded-route defect and recapture only after it is corrected.

items.expect: Every required selected matrix entry has capture, screenshot and verdict with lawful deferrals.

onFail.instruction: List missing matrix entries and capture only those; never shrink frozen scope to pass.

items.expect: Every judged claim traces to an actual measured node and applicable rule.

onFail.instruction: Name the unmeasured claim or mismatched citation and recapture its matrix entry.

items.expect: All eight audit topics close independently by their rules and route failures to owners.

onFail.instruction: Name the open or incorrectly closed topic and reassess it from existing measurements or new required evidence.

items.expect: Actual screenshots pass calibrated visual review over the frozen scope.

onFail.instruction: Record visible defects and calibration mismatch, then reassess the unchanged scope after targeted product repair and recapture.

items.expect: Browser, image inspection and file capabilities are available.

onFail.instruction: Return the missing audit capability; do not infer browser evidence.

items.expect: Surface scope, rule authority and served-route evidence are complete.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the exact missing scope or evidence; do not choose a surface class or rule.

items.expect: Browser actions and captures have known outcomes.

onFail.instruction: Inspect current browser and artifact state before recapturing only the incomplete matrix entry.

criteria.stopWhen: Stop after two feedback rounds, recurring defects, missing authority, unavailable browser evidence or unlawful scope deferral. Done requires every machine and review criterion to pass on current captures.

purpose: Observe frozen primary interface surfaces on the attested route, capture and measure every selected matrix entry, and judge each claimed rule against its bound authority.

request.description: Bind the source application, presentation ownership, direction decision, route, served-head evidence, surface class and frozen audit matrix. Include an account record by name for guarded routes and seeded-volume evidence when a criterion depends on data density.
request.title: interface.audit request

response.description: A done response contains the frozen audit report, measured captures, actual PNG screenshots and topic verdicts. Measurements and verdicts remain distinct; a screenshot alone never establishes conformance.
response.title: interface.audit response

scope: Read-only interface audit. It changes no source, runtime, account, data, design direction or knowledge rule. It may create browser walks and durable audit artifacts only inside the work record.

calls.purpose: Read the frozen scope and only bound authority.
Verify served-head ancestry for the applied commit.

steps.instruction: Read the exact request and declared files. Freeze applied commit, route, served-head evidence, presentation ownership, surface class, selected primary surfaces and every required matrix entry. Do not silently defer a journey-required state.
produces: Frozen audit matrix and rule inventory.

calls.purpose: Reach the selected rendered state in an isolated browser context.

steps.instruction: Open the exact attested endpoint in a dedicated browser context, sign in by credential name when guarded, and wait for the requested state and representative data. Capture nothing until credential fields are absent and the state is ready.

calls.purpose: Drive, capture and measure each selected matrix entry.

steps.instruction: Execute the written walk for every matrix entry. Persist the actual screenshot and browser-produced DOM or computed-style measurements for every claim-bearing node. A capture without its walk result and measurements is incomplete.

reads.when: when a written walk is supplied

calls.purpose: Inspect actual screenshots at useful detail.
Persist topic verdicts and audit report.

steps.instruction: Inspect screenshots and measurement records together. Judge every claimed rule by its node owner, close the eight proof topics independently, and score taste over the frozen scope using the complete calibration anchors. Record concrete defects for recapture or reassessment.
produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write the response with actual paths and hashes, observations and evidence-backed review results. Validate it and present the worst relevant capture beside the verdict. Do not claim full-state coverage from a primary-surface audit.

validate.failurePolicy: Use the bounded feedback loop to identify exact missing captures, measurements, rules or visual defects, recapture or reassess only the affected matrix entries, and return done only after every criterion passes.

review.instruction: Confirm the endpoint and served head come from the bound runtime evidence, the served head contains the applied commit, the actual rendered family version is recorded, and guarded routes were reached without exposing credentials.

Confirm every selected primary surface and required viewport, color scheme and journey state has a capture, screenshot and verdict; deferred states have reasons and no journey-required state was silently deferred.

Trace every judged claim to a measured rendered node, its owner, applicable rule and actual browser evidence. Reject claimed values, screenshots without measurements and measurements copied from another matrix entry.

Confirm presentation, composition, responsive, motion, accessibility, contrast, render truth and taste close independently by their published rules, with unavailable evidence blocked rather than passed and failures routed to the node owner.
Inspect every actual screenshot and verify taste scoring used the same auditor, frozen scope and complete calibration anchors. Check the worst relevant capture remains visible with the verdict.
